curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42035-1-2.pdf (the mining truck, numbered 1 on its cover); omr/instructions/42035-1-1.pdf builds the B model

functions.does: The black gear on top of the tall yellow column behind the cab steers the front wheels: the column's knob gear turns a knob gear on a lengthwise axle, whose 12-tooth gear at the front drives a steering rack between the front wheels.
functions.source: book: steps 3-9 (pages 4-10), the steering column step 10 (page 13), step 12 (page 16, the inset shows a front wheel's hub turning)

functions.does: As the truck rolls, the right rear wheel drives the engine: its 20-tooth bevel gear turns a 12-tooth bevel on a long shaft running forward, which turns an 8-tooth sprocket whose chain drives a 16-tooth gear on the crankshaft, pumping the piston up and down in its cylinder under the bonnet.
functions.source: book: steps 5 and 17 (pages 8, 24, the chain), the engine steps; inferred: the order of the gears from the model file

functions.does: The left rear wheel rolls freely on its own axle.
functions.source: inferred: it isn't geared to the drive shaft (book step 33, page 60)

functions.does: The two front wheels roll freely on their steering hubs.
The black gear on the axle sticking out of the left side behind the cab tips the dump body: it turns cranks under the body, which push a link up and tip the body back on its hinge at the rear.
functions.source: book: steps 26-29 and 31 (pages 36-39, 56-58; the finger on page 56 lifts the body)
